resources.string: This week\'s grades, lessons, tests and announcements from Librus Synergia.
Use the Synergia login, not the Konto Librus e-mail. Passwords are stored in the Android Keystore on this device only. Unofficial app, not affiliated with Librus.
The Librus client hasn\'t been wired up yet — login is a placeholder.
The week view will show grades, tests, cancelled lessons and announcements once the Librus client is implemented.
Changes apply the next time the app starts. “System” follows the device language.
